title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #8 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is the birth of Jesus unique? (1 mark)
   A. He was born in a rich home
   B. He was born in a palace
   C. He was conceived by the Holy Spirit
   D. He was born in Egypt

2. What does the name Jesus mean? (1 mark)
   A. Father of many
   B. Great king
   C. Gift
   D. The Lord saves

3. Which angel appeared to Zechariah? (1 mark)
   A. Uriel
   B. Raphael
   C. Gabriel
   D. Michael

4. Where did John preach? (1 mark)
   A. Near the River Jordan
   B. In Antioch
   C. In Rome
   D. In Egypt

5. What did he ask Jesus for? (1 mark)
   A. A house
   B. Money
   C. Food
   D. Mercy, and to see

6. Which Gospel records the healing of Bartimaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Mark
   B. Genesis
   C. Romans
   D. Acts

7. Leprosy today can be treated with: (1 mark)
   A. Charms
   B. Nothing
   C. Medicine
   D. Prayer only, without doctors

8. When were the ten men healed? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. After many years
   C. As they went
   D. Before they heard Him

9. In which town did Jesus raise the widow's son? (1 mark)
   A. Nazareth
   B. Nain
   C. Jericho
   D. Cana

10. Which of these is an act of compassion? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring a lonely child
   B. Comforting a grieving friend
   C. Laughing at a friend's loss
   D. Teasing a sad friend

11. If someone keeps hurting you even after you forgive, what should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Say nothing forever
   B. Tell a trusted adult
   C. Hurt them
   D. Hit back

12. A classmate breaks your pencil by accident. What is the best response? (1 mark)
   A. Forgive and accept the apology
   B. Shout at him
   C. Tell others lies
   D. Break his pencil

13. Which verse tells us to give to the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Matthew 5:42
   C. Acts 2:38
   D. John 3:16

14. How many silver coins did the woman have? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Two
   C. Five
   D. Twelve

15. What does the mustard seed stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The small beginning of God's kingdom
   B. A rich king
   C. A big city
   D. The end of the world

16. What does the kingdom of God mean? (1 mark)
   A. A country in Europe
   B. God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   C. A big farm
   D. A school

17. Which of these shows a good response to John 3:16? (1 mark)
   A. Blaming others
   B. Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   C. Ignoring God
   D. Forgetting the verse

18. Which of these is a sign of an unsafe secret? (1 mark)
   A. It is about a surprise gift
   B. It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   C. It makes you happy
   D. It is about a game

19. Who was tempted by Potiphar's wife? (1 mark)
   A. Abraham
   B. Joseph
   C. Samson
   D. Daniel

20. Which of these is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Returning lost money
   B. Admitting a mistake
   C. Saying sorry
   D. Copying in a test

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State three things that show that Nicodemus changed. (3 marks)

22. Describe how the boy in John 6 shows that small gifts can do great things. (4 marks)

23. Explain how Ephesians 4:25 can be applied by a child in the classroom. (5 marks)

24. What is a mustard seed like, and what does it grow into? (2 marks)

25. State three challenges that children may face and how they can involve God. (3 marks)

26. Describe how Mary responded to the angel's message. (3 marks)

27. Describe three steps you can follow to forgive someone. (3 marks)

28. Explain what the healing of Bartimaeus teaches about Jesus. (3 marks)

29. Who were the parents of John the Baptist? (2 marks)

30. Why was the widow of Nain in great need? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — He was conceived by the Holy Spirit
   Jesus was conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.

2. D — The Lord saves
   Matthew 1:21 links His name to saving people from their sins.

3. C — Gabriel
   Gabriel said, "I stand in the presence of God."

4. A — Near the River Jordan
   John preached in the wilderness by the Jordan.

5. D — Mercy, and to see
   He asked for mercy and said, "I want to see."

6. A — Mark
   Mark 10:46-52 tells the story.

7. C — Medicine
   Leprosy can be cured with medicine from health workers.

8. C — As they went
   Luke 17:14 says they were cleansed as they went.

9. B — Nain
   Luke 7:11 says Nain.

10. B — Comforting a grieving friend
   Comfort shows care.

11. B — Tell a trusted adult
   Forgiveness does not mean staying in danger.

12. A — Forgive and accept the apology
   Forgiveness restores friendship.

13. B — Matthew 5:42
   Matthew 5:42 says to give to the one who asks.

14. A — Ten
   She had ten silver coins.

15. A — The small beginning of God's kingdom
   God's kingdom began small.

16. B — God's rule in the hearts of people who obey Him
   God's kingdom is His rule.

17. B — Believing in Jesus and thanking God
   We respond with faith and thanks.

18. B — It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   Bad secrets should be told to trusted adults.

19. B — Joseph
   Genesis 39 tells the story of Joseph.

20. D — Copying in a test
   Copying is cheating.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: He defended Jesus fairly; he brought spices for Jesus' burial; he showed courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid sign.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: The boy shared five loaves and two fish. Jesus used them to feed a large crowd. This shows that a small gift given willingly can help many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy sharing, 1 for the food, 1 for Jesus feeding many, 1 for the lesson.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: Put off falsehood and speak truthfully because we are all members of one body. A child should not cheat, should admit mistakes, should not blame others, and should tell the teacher what really happened.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verse meaning, 1 for not cheating, 1 for admitting mistakes, 1 for not blaming, 1 for telling the truth kindly.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: A very small seed that grows into a large tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Illness, loss of a loved one, lack of school fees, bullying, exams. They can pray, trust God and ask trusted adults for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid challenge with a way of involving God, up to 3.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was troubled at first, asked how it could happen since she was a virgin, and then accepted, saying she was the Lord's servant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for being troubled or asking, 1 for how, 1 for accepting.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Calm down; think about what happened; talk to the person kindly; say I forgive you; pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus has power over sickness. He cares about the poor and those who suffer. He responds to faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Zechariah and Elizabeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each name.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: She had lost her husband and now her only son, so she had nobody to provide for her.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the husband and 1 for the son.
